items.title: These 5 Dividend Stocks Survived 2008, COVID and Every Recession Before Them
items.summary: Chasing the fattest yield on the screen is a trap most income investors fall into, but a handful of companies have quietly raised their payouts through oil shocks, financial meltdowns, and a global pandemic without skipping a beat. The question is what they all have in common.

items.title: New Whoppers, Higher Quality: Inside Burger King’s Big Revamp
items.summary: Burger King is making a comeback. The fast food chain has seen increased sales and foot traffic, which the company’s U.S. president Tom Curtis credits to their updated signature burger, the Whopper. WSJ’s Heather Haddon sat down with Curtis and visited the Burger King test kitchen to find out how they plan to make it last.
